answer: Promotion out of probation requires 8 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the dune record is per identity, the quill audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, as every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's vault standing. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
